owned_invariants: This module decides nothing: every verdict it returns was computed by the Rust host pfp_operad.
A host that is missing, cannot run, times out, prints no outcome or refuses the request raises OperadHostError; there is no fallback verdict.
The host is found at PFP_OPERAD_BIN, then on PATH, then in a checkout's code/rust/target build directory.
identity() is the host's own statement of its name, version and canon.
boundaries: Trusts the binary it is pointed at; it does not verify the binary's hash.
Python moves the request and the outcome and applies no rule.

score.level_basis: A transport with one job: closed error codes for every way the host can fail to answer, no fallback verdict, strict JSON on the way back, and the host's identity bound into every run.

basis.G1: Module docstring states the role and AuthorityEffect None; the contract names every exported symbol. Not B: no requirement-to-symbol trace beyond docs/plans/operads_redesign.md.
basis.G2: No arithmetic and no comparison of results. Requests are written with allow_nan=False; outcomes are read with the strict JSON reader.
basis.G3: Four closed error codes (OPERAD_HOST_NOT_FOUND, OPERAD_HOST_DID_NOT_RUN, OPERAD_HOST_NO_OUTCOME, OPERAD_HOST_REFUSED), each tested; a 60 second timeout. Not B: the timeout path is not exercised by a test.
basis.G4: 15 tests in pfp/workflows/tests/test_operad_host.py plus the 639-test workflow suite that reaches the host through it. The three survivors are the timeout constant, the cache size of a zero-argument function and ASCII escaping of the request file, which the host reads to the same value. Not B: one generated campaign, no property tests. Mutation campaign R = 24/27.
basis.G5: Measured worst cyclomatic 5, cognitive 5, nesting 2; ceiling A+, recorded A.

evidence.note: 639 offline tests (pfp/workflows, pfp_core/workflow_families, exclusions) against the release build of pfp_operad 0.3.0; exact source inputs bound. No live model performance claim.
